{{Attr|Tank}} (Variable) }} ==Description== The '''Korblox Undead''' was an enemy that appeared in [[The Hunt: Mega Edition Event]]. It also appears in [[The Classic Event]] missions as part of [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. It has a high amount of health and walks at the same speed as the [[Korblox Seeker (The Hunt: Mega Edition)|Korblox Seeker]]. ==Logbook Description== "''Infused with the Cold Fire from the Frost Flame tribe, the Korblox Undead were created from the bodies of fallen Bloodbringers. Lacking heads, the Skullhelm tribe adorned them with the skulls of mages who had died in battle at Wizard's Tower. Rumors suggest that one of the Korblox Undead bears the skull of the Dark Wizard.''" ==Appearance== The '''Korblox Undead''' has blue skin. It does not have a head or a torso, exposing its skeleton. It also has a skull, which is not its own skull and instead a skull from fallen mages. It wears a grey chestplate, shoulder-pads, arm-pads, knee-pads, shoes and pants, and it also has a blue cape. Its skull has blue flames coming out of it. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Korblox Temple]] is listed instead. *Multiple early game towers like the [[Militant]], [[Shotgunner]], [[Medic]], [[Electroshocker]] and [[Brawler]] can be used to deal with this. *As [[Korblox Temple]] gives a lot of cash per wave, high DPS towers like the [[Turret]], [[Accelerator]], [[Pursuit]] or [[Golden Minigunner]] can easily be afforded to deal with this, though this is not necessary as early-game towers on their own can deal with them just fine. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} KorbloxUndeadWalk.gif|Walking animation (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseUndead.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Thumbnails}} TheHuntMegaThumbnail.png|'''Korblox Undead''' on the game thumbnail. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Images}} TheHuntMegaEditionPI.png|'''Korblox Undead''' on a promotional image. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} The Hunt- Mega Edition Trailer -
